entry.title: Cincinnati Reds staff and front office: The #reds have named Joe Torres as their new pitching coach. Torres had been the assistant pitching coach with the Guardians for the past five seasons including 2022-23 under Terry Francona.
Cincinnati Reds roster moves and needs: I will be co-hosting the Hot Stove show with Jim Day on WLW and the #reds radio network tonight at 6 p.m. Terry Francona and Joe Torres are the guests.
